description: §7.2.2 rule 10: `fail⏎E.V(…);` and `fail⏎.V;` are `fail` statements — the contextual keyword is read regardless of line.
rationale: user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — statement termination follow-ups, §7.2.2" item 3 ("Keyword at statement start"): "Each is a keyword at statement start whenever the next token can begin its operand, regardless of line."
